feeds.description: View featured Local news stories, Videos, and Op-eds. The Nevada Independent is a local, nonpartisan, news and opinion website founded by veteran political journalist and commentator Jon Ralston. The site and its supporting channels focus on ethical, unbiased, and transparent journalism and aim to gather and disseminate important public information.
